02 / THE PRACTICE

Make the claim match the evidence.

AI makes it easier to explore. A useful result still needs a clear question, a working implementation and an honest account of its limits.

  1. Frame a question

    Name a concrete behavior to change or prediction to test. Keep the scope small enough to finish.

  2. Build with a trail

    Use AI assistance openly. Keep versions, checks and public evidence separate from private data.

  3. Observe, then qualify

    Report the observed result. Keep simulations, public scores and pending reviews in their proper context.

Complete field notes

ContextWeave

Question

How can a low-cost model predict perturbed cells when final biological contexts are anonymous?

Approach

AI-assisted implementation combines public Perturb-seq mean effects with each context’s own controls. A streamed generator and validator handle the final count matrix without loading it all into memory.

Observed result

Generated 360,000 predicted cells for the Virtual Cell Challenge 2026 final. The single final submission reached the official published terminal state without an error; no official score or rank is available.

Limits

Direct support covers 277/300 targets and 7,681/18,533 genes. The remaining 23 targets and 10,852 genes have zero learned effect; a separate 0.1 own-target prior is applied. Shared effects are not learned final-context specificity. Full biological covariance is unvalidated; local proxy improvement is not an official score or clinical evidence.

View public evidence ↗

Enveda CASMI26

Question

How can exact mass and spectral similarity narrow a molecular-structure search?

Approach

AI-assisted implementation filters candidates by exact mass, ranks spectral similarity and deduplicates structures using the official training data.

Observed result

Version 2 completed official scoring with a Kaggle public score of 0.151 and remains selected as one of the two final slots.

Limits

This is a scored retrieval baseline. The public score is not a final private score, final rank, award or guarantee of chemical identification; challenge data and the private notebook are not redistributed.

View public evidence ↗

Smart Buildings — ZoneGuard

Question

How can a controller balance multiple zones that share heating resources?

Approach

AI-assisted implementation uses zone heating and cooling demand to adjust airflow and reheat while coordinating the shared hot-water loop in the competition simulator.

Observed result

The competition submission achieved a Kaggle public score of 0.04881 and is selected for final evaluation (one of two allowed selections).

Limits

The public score does not establish a final private ranking, an award or measured savings in a real building. This is competition simulation work, not a deployed building controller.

View public evidence ↗

RAIDLINE

Question

How can chat participation leave a shared story beyond a single broadcast?

Approach

AI-assisted implementation connects chat and raid events to shared game rules, a railway world, broadcast goals and archived chapter memories. A public practice experience makes the interaction explorable without Twitch authorization.

Observed result

The interactive application is published with English, Traditional Chinese and Japanese interfaces, and the project has a recorded formal competition submission.

Limits

The recorded live test contains four commands from one account. Multi-person relays and incoming raids remain supported by synthetic practice and automated checks, not a verified live community session. No measured engagement gain is claimed.

View public evidence ↗

VERSIONPASS

Question

When two files share a name, how do we know which revision was approved?

Approach

AI-assisted implementation compares file fingerprints locally, records delivery and approval on Solana devnet, and exports receipts for independent reimport and verification.

Observed result

A real devnet demonstration verified two finalized delivery/approval transactions, a matching original file and rejection of changed bytes under the same filename. Final checkpoint content was submitted once and verified after reload.

Limits

A devnet prototype using synthetic file content and temporary keys. It does not establish legal identity, durable key recovery or mainnet readiness. Saved final fields were verified; no separate submission ID or Submitted badge was observed.

View public evidence ↗ · Public source ↗

Abby Vue

Question

How can a Vue integration preserve typing and keep provider state isolated across applications?

Approach

AI-assisted implementation adds typed composables, application/provider isolation and SSR-safe initialization. The public interactive demonstration uses synthetic data and sends no telemetry.

Observed result

A non-draft upstream contribution was opened as PR #211 with a demonstration and claim. Two recorded review threads were resolved; upstream review and authorization remain external.

Limits

The latest saved evidence records an open, unmerged PR. Merge, release, successful upstream CI and bounty payment are not confirmed.
